description:
Join a dedicated team as a Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) at a premier skilled nursing facility in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate COTA to make a significant impact on patients' lives, helping them regain independence and improve their quality of life through therapeutic interventions.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, assisting patients with various activities of daily living, therapeutic exercises, and adaptive equipment training. Your expertise will contribute to developing and implementing individualized treatment plans, fostering a supportive and healing environment for all residents.

We are seeking a committed professional ready to contribute to a collaborative healthcare setting. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to be part of a team dedicated to exceptional patient care.
requirements: Current state licensure as a COTA in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, compensation based on experience.
